result.rationale: The diff shows `saveChanges()` in admin-embedding.js.es6 is exactly `this.get('embedding').update({});` — no return, no `.then`, no `.catch`. The same PR's embeddable-host.js.es6 uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)` for its save, confirming the codebase convention is to surface ajax failures; here a failed update produces no error UI, no disabled state, nothing. The mechanism (ignored rejected promise -> silent failure) is directly verifiable from the diff. What cannot be verified from the diff alone is whether the model's `update()` internally pops up errors, hence moderate confidence.
